Death teleports now follow the exact moving backpack and prefer a reachable landing 2–4 blocks away (maximum 6 horizontal blocks). Add the Nexus-owned Phasing effect combining Weakness I, Night Vision, Invisibility and Resistance I; it ends 3 seconds after successful recovery. Compasses, recovery compasses and maps can teleport outside arrays; recognized array construction adds stability. Requires TotemCore 0.7.19 or newer; update Remnant to 0.2.24 for live backpack movement and pickup callbacks.
